hero.title: Nourish a Life. Uplift a Soul.
hero.subtitle: Your support delivers food, education, and hope to those who need it most.
hero.decidePathDesc: of your kindness - Your help leads to hope and transformation
donate.subheading: Support our mission to provide food, education, and care to those in need. Your contribution brings hope and changes lives.
donate.tabs.annadaan.title: Annadaan
donate.tabs.annadaan.shortDesc: No child should have to study on an empty stomach. Through Annadaan, we serve warm, wholesome meals every day.
donate.tabs.annadaan.longDesc: Bringing not just nourishment, but love, care, and the strength to dream. Every plate we serve carries hope, every meal we provide builds stronger foundations for education, and every child we feed gets one step closer to breaking the cycle of poverty through knowledge and opportunity.
donate.tabs.vidyaDaan.title: Vidya Daan
donate.tabs.vidyaDaan.shortDesc: Education is the light that breaks the darkness of poverty. Through free tuition, we give children the chance to learn and thrive.
donate.tabs.vidyaDaan.longDesc: We provide comprehensive educational support, study materials, and guidance to underprivileged students. Your contribution ensures that financial constraints do not hinder a child's right to quality education and a brighter future.
donate.tabs.generalSeva.title: General Seva
donate.tabs.generalSeva.desc: General Seva encompasses various initiatives including temple maintenance, community welfare, and emergency relief programs. By supporting General Seva, you enable us to direct resources where they are needed most urgently, ensuring sustainable and impactful service to society.
about.causeHeadingPart1: The cause for which we are
about.hdgTitle: His Divine Grace Abhay Charanaravinda Bhaktivedanta Swami
about.hkmFoundedBy: HARE KRISHNA MOVEMENT INDIA (HKM) was founded by His Divine Grace
about.devoteesDescription: by devotees affectionately; a man of many facets, a versatile personality, and more. He has been called a scholar, a philosopher, a cultural ambassador, a prolific author, a social critic, and a holy man at various times. In truth, he was all these things and more.
about.foodDistribution: On his order HKM is carrying out massive food distribution programs with the support from respective governments and CSR funding from corporates.
about.everyChildDeserves: Because every child deserves a chance to learn, grow, and thrive no matter where they come from.
about.purposeOfEducation: The purpose of education is to develop all round and well-balanced students. This is achieved by integrated curriculum of Hare Krishna Vidya, which puts value education and life skills into the curriculum along with school subjects.
about.designedForStudents: "Hare Krishna Vidya" is designed for underprivileged students of classes 1st to 10th, especially in rural areas.
about.affiliatedNonProfit: Hare Krishna Vidya affiliated to HARE KRISHNA MOVEMENT INDIA Hyderabad which is a non-profit organization on a mission to empower every single child from rural areas, through free education.
about.eveningTuitions: Hare Krishna Vidya organizes evening tuitions under the care of trained teachers, systematically. Teacher focuses on teaching life skills, values to children, and organizes study programs to complete homework, read subjects and doubts will be clarified through teacher and peer learning.
about.mission.paragraph: At Hare Krishna Vidya, our mission is to empower underprivileged children from rural communities by nurturing not just their minds, but their hearts and hopes too. We believe that every child, regardless of their socio-economic background, deserves the chance to thrive and that education, nourishment, and values are the pillars of true empowerment.
about.mission.howWeBringToLife: Here's how we bring this mission to life:
about.vision.paragraphDesktop: Our vision is to create a world where every child, regardless of their background, has access to quality education, proper nutrition, and the opportunity to develop strong moral values. We envision communities where children are empowered to break the cycle of poverty through holistic development.
about.vision.paragraphMobile: We envision a world where every child is given the wings to rise, not just survive. A future where learning is joyful, nourishing is dignified, and values are woven into the heart of education.
